translationRepairs: Prince Xian Ji'ai, Zhuang's eldest son by a secondary consort, was first made Prince of Wuling and succeeded to the main line during the Zhengtong reign; he died in year 8 without heirs. Prince Kang Ji'ang, Zhuang's second son by a secondary consort, was first Prince of Qianyang, was raised to princely rank in Zhengtong 9, and died in Tianshun 6, also leaving no sons.
